issues.description: No source panels used by the programs are included; the release contains the four program texts, datasheet, code-description, appendix, and a firm-ID lookup workbook. Required CSMAR/iFinD tables, CICPA/CSRC records, author-manual classifications, and other prepared tables remain unverified; the assigned catalog shows no compatible exact product candidate.

Program 1 requires manual resolution of Chinese auditor homonyms and an auditor's firm-by-year uniqueness; the workflow also uses manually adjusted firm-name history, CICPA person/office records, manually coded MAO/restate links, and punishment crosswalks. The specific identity decisions and complete history are not included.

Program 3 consumes auditfirmmerge.dta, described as manually analyzed and carrying event-time rows t−2/t−1/t/t+1 plus a merger indicator, but no supplied file or complete producer/source contract establishes those values.

Program 4's visible builder renames dretwd to return, merges the market source by trddt, and renames cdretwdeq to market. Later CAR/beta consumers require ret, market_return, and date; the documented ret_daily schema also names those variables. No source header proves an intended alias or date conversion, so leave it unresolved rather than guessing a rename.

All four supplied .txt files are readable plain-text Stata program sources. No unified ordered driver or code-level working-directory setup is supplied; preserve Program 1 → Program 2 Part I → Program 3 lines 31–48 → Program 2 Table 1 Panel D and remaining sections → Program 3 remainder → Program 4. Relative inputs and outputs must resolve consistently. The TXT suffix alone is not a conversion blocker.

The supplied code reads/merges big10.dta and then uses big6, but the author description of big10.dta lists only accfir, year, big4, and big10. The absent input's actual source columns and intended meaning of big6 are unknown; do not guess or rename it.

Program 1 reads license.dta and describes a firm-year license-suspension indicator, but the datasheet does not identify its source table or provide its construction; a CSRC punishment record is not assumed equivalent.

**convert txt file to dta file **
insheet using cpaname.txt,clear
keep stkcd year accfir name1 name2 name3 change_f
save cpaname.dta,replace

insheet using punish_p.txt,clear
sort name year_p
bysort name:keep if _n==1
gen punish=1
save punish_p.dta,replace

insheet using cpadetail.txt,clear
keep name flag gender education year_birth year_cpa university major office_me
save cpadetail.dta,replace

insheet using gc_only.txt,clear
save gc_only.dta,replace


insheet using restate.txt,clear
drop if restate_type==2&tax_policy==1
drop if restate_type==0
keep stkcd year_disclose year_event 
gen restate=1
bysort stkcd year_disclose year_event:keep if _n==1
save restate.dta,replace

evidence.quote:
*PART I  copute ratio_restate(Restate%) and DRestate *DirectMAO for each auditor at year t
*PART II compute DRestate *NonDirectMAO for each auditor at year t

*********************PART I:  copute ratio_restate(Restate%) and DRestate *DirectMAO for each auditor at year t*****************************

use cpaname.dta,clear
drop name1 name2 name3
merge 1:1 stkcd year using auditopin.dta
keep if _merge==3
drop _merge

merge m:1 stkcd using stkcd_delist.dta
drop if _merge==2
drop if year>=year_delist-2 & _merge==3
drop _merge


drop if stkcd>=200000&stkcd<300000
drop if stkcd>=900000
merge 1:1 stkcd year using gc_only.dta
drop if _merge==3
drop gc_only _merge

****whether MAOs are followed by related restatement in the next two years****
merge 1:1 stkcd year using mao_restate.dta,keepusing(mao_restate)
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
replace mao_restate=0 if mao_restate==.

**whether the financial statements at year t were restated at year t+1 or t+2, that means the year of being restated is year t, and the year of restatement announcement is year t+1/ t+2**
gen year_disclose=year+1
gen year_event=year
merge 1:1 stkcd year_disclose year_event using restate.dta
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
replace restate=0 if restate==.
rename restate restate_t_p1
drop year_disclose year_event

gen year_disclose=year+2
gen year_event=year
merge 1:1 stkcd year_disclose year_event using restate.dta
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
replace restate=0 if restate==.
rename restate restate_t_p2
drop year_disclose year_event

**define mao (qualified or disclaimer)**
gen mao=1 if auditopin>=3&auditopin<.
replace mao=0 if auditopin<=2
drop if mao==.

*whether year t clients are restated at year t+1 or t+2*
gen restate_t_p12=1 if restate_t_p1==1|restate_t_p2==1
replace restate_t_p12=0 if restate_t_p12==.

*whether year t clients are restated at year t+1, without related mao in advance**
gen nmao_restate_t=1 if mao_restate==0&restate_t_p1==1
replace nmao_restate_t=0 if nmao_restate_t==.

*whether year t clients are restated at year t+1 or t+2, without related mao in advance**
gen nmao_restate_t_p1=1 if mao_restate==0&restate_t_p12==1
replace nmao_restate_t_p1=0 if nmao_restate_t_p1==.

*whether year t clients are restated at year t+2, without related mao in advance**
gen nmao_restate_t_p2=1 if mao_restate==0&restate_t_p2==1
replace nmao_restate_t_p2=0 if nmao_restate_t_p2==.


merge 1:m stkcd year using name_col_adj.dta
keep if _merge==3
drop _merge

**compute num of client**
bysort name year:gen freq=_N
bysort name year:egen freq_mao=sum(mao)

**restatement, without related mao in advance**
bysort name year:egen freq_nmao_restate_t=sum(nmao_restate_t)
bysort name year:egen freq_nmao_restate_t_p1=sum(nmao_restate_t_p1)
bysort name year:egen freq_nmao_restate_t_p2=sum(nmao_restate_t_p2)
**restatement**
bysort name year:egen freq_restate_t=sum(restate_t_p1)
bysort name year:egen freq_restate_t_p1=sum(restate_t_p12)
bysort name year:egen freq_restate_t_p2=sum(restate_t_p2)

bysort name year:keep if _n==1
drop stkcd

*******for an auditor at year t, what about their clients at year t-1*******
sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_m1=freq[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==1
replace freq_m1=0 if freq_m1==.

sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_mao_m1=freq_mao[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==1
replace freq_mao_m1=0 if freq_mao_m1==.

sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_nmao_restate_t_m1=freq_nmao_restate_t_p1[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==1
replace freq_nmao_restate_t_m1=0 if freq_nmao_restate_t_m1==.

sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_restate_t_m1=freq_restate_t_p1[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==1
replace freq_restate_t_m1=0 if freq_restate_t_m1==.

*******for an auditor at year t, what about their clients at year t-2*******
sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_m2=freq[_n-2] if year-year[_n-2]==2
bysort name:replace freq_m2=freq[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==2
replace freq_m2=0 if freq_m2==.

sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_mao_m2=freq_mao[_n-2] if year-year[_n-2]==2
bysort name:replace freq_mao_m2=freq_mao[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==2
replace freq_mao_m2=0 if freq_mao_m2==.


sort name year
bysort name:gen freq_nmao_restate_t_m2=freq_nmao_restate_t_p2[_n-2] if year-year[_n-2]==2
bysort name:replace freq_nmao_restate_t_m2=freq_nmao_restate_t_p2[_n-1] if year-year[_n-1]==2
replace freq_nmao_restate_t_m2=0 if freq_nmao_restate_t_m2==.

sort name year
